name: histc
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::histc(Tensor self, int bins=100, Scalar min=0, Scalar max=0) -> Tensor. Computes a one-dimensional histogram with optional automatic range selection without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover deterministic bucket-centered float32 values, legacy shapes and bin counts, explicit and automatic ranges, endpoints and outliers, empty and noncontiguous tensors, output metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid bins or reversed ranges.
